name: Settings Homepage Item
author: LeeGarChat
description: Injects Pixel Extra Parts into a separate top-level Settings homepage area without modifying the Settings package.

settings.title: Show Pixel Extra Parts in Settings
settings.description: Enables the injected top-level Settings homepage item.

settings.title: Settings Menu Position
settings.description: Lower values are shown closer to the top of Settings.

settings.title: Use Colored Icon
settings.description: Uses the Pixel Extra Parts launcher icon. Disabled uses the blue Settings homepage icon.
